data.message: I commit to 18 tons and invite each of you to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. Versus 10, 18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, 250−8k remain; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). All 25 at 18 leave 50, avoiding immediate collapse, but next stock could be 100; long-run gains aren't guaranteed. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation. Each person: state your exact intended catch and any conditions.
